name: Сетевой проигрыватель Arcam RADIA ST5
descriptionHtml:
Сетевой проигрыватель Arcam RADIA ST5 — Network streamer/media player designed as a high-resolution upgrade and control-linked companion for Arcam Radia integrated amplifiers. Характеристики ниже — только с страницы/листа производителя.

  • FLAC, WAV (LPCM), MQA, AAC, ALAC, AIFF, DSD up to 128
  • Maximum PCM resolution: 24-bit/192 kHz
  • Outputs: Stereo RCA analogue; S/PDIF coaxial RCA; optical Toslink
  • Frequency response: 20 Hz–20 kHz ±0.05 dB
  • Power consumption: 12 W; eco standby <0.5 W

Характеристики производителя

Supported high-resolution media: FLAC, WAV (LPCM), MQA, AAC, ALAC, AIFF, DSD up to 128 · Maximum PCM resolution: 24-bit/192 kHz · Outputs: Stereo RCA analogue; S/PDIF coaxial RCA; optical Toslink · Frequency response: 20 Hz–20 kHz ±0.05 dB · Power consumption: 12 W; eco standby <0.5 W · Dimensions: 431 × 344 × 58 mm (W × D × H, including feet).

Supports Spotify Connect, Tidal Connect, Qobuz Connect, Apple AirPlay, Google Cast and Roon Ready; ESS ES9018 DAC; Wi-Fi or Ethernet network connection.
